name: Jesse Battles

items.text: In February 2026 the Alabama Republican Party's steering committee removed Battles from the Republican primary ballot. A challenge said he broke party rules by doing paid political work in 2018 for an independent who ran against a Republican. Battles says the party misapplied its own six-year rule. He then qualified as an Independent.
items.why: This is a private party's ballot rule dispute, not an official finding of misconduct, and it doesn't clearly bear on any of the criteria.
This is the same ballot-removal matter as item 1, and Ballotpedia's withdrawn-or-disqualified listing gives no reason or separate conduct.

for_review: The owner-site search (Battles with alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing about Battles. I did not read the original ballot challenge or the party's written decision, only news reports. The Alabama Gazette dateline says Feb. 15 but its URL says Feb. 1; other outlets say mid-February. An opponent-run site (realjessebattles.com) claims he paid a lawyer $5,000 and overstated his role with JSU College Republicans. I did not open it and didn't verify either claim. The Nov. 2026 general election is extremely close (Battles led by about 52 votes in unofficial returns, and a recount is possible), so check the result. I also did not check his campaign finance filings or his business record.
